title: Invite code
summary: Asks for the invite code when sign-up needs one and no invite came with a link. A valid code continues to the name step.

code.description: What the person typed or pasted. A whole invite link or message is fine; the app takes the code out of it.

phase.description: checking: GET /v1/invites/{code} runs. invalid: the server says valid false, or the text holds no code.

error.description: String key of the error under the field: bipe_error_invite_invalid, bipe_invite_no_longer_valid (an invite from a link that stopped being valid, onboarding-welcome primary), bipe_error_network or bipe_error_rate_limited.

editCode.effect: Sets code and clears the error.

pasteCode.effect: Reads the clipboard once, only after a tap (iOS: the system PasteButton, so no paste prompt; Android: a text button with bipe_onboarding_paste_invite). The text becomes code, then submit runs. Text with no code ends in phase invalid, as for typed text.

scanCode.effect: bipe_onboarding_scan_invite opens a sheet with the camera (bipe_app_invite_scan_title, bipe_app_invite_scan_body, the same QR reader as link-computer-scan) and bipe_app_cancel. The first QR code read closes the sheet; its text becomes code, then submit runs, as for pasteCode. Text with no code ends in phase invalid. Camera denied: bipe_camera_permission_body and a button to the app settings.

submit.effect: Takes the code from the text and runs GET /v1/invites/{code}. valid true: goes to signup-name with the invite. valid false: phase invalid. Continue is off while code is blank.

notes: Shown only for the inviteOnly start variant. An invite from a link skips it (registries/onboarding.json steps.inviteCode).

Code extraction follows test-vectors/invite-codes.json. Bipe logic: BipeInviteLink.normalizedCode and BipeAPIClient.invitePreview (iOS), BipeInviteLink.normalizedCode and BipeApiClient.invitePreview (Android).
The screen never says why a code is not valid (used, expired, revoked): the server does not tell either.
POST /v1/signup checks the code again; signup-create handles invite_invalid there.
